environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native image deployed on AWS Lambda with custom runtime. Process executes within a pivot_root jail (not traditional chroot) configured via the Lambda extension bootstrap shim. The jail root is /var/task/sandbox/ which is populated at cold-start with only the application binary and a generated ephemeral 16-byte key file. The /data/profiles/ directory within the jail contains only stub JSON files with non-sensitive placeholder data (display names and theme preferences). The OCI layer manifest specifies no additional filesystem mounts. The Lambda execution role has no S3, Secrets Manager, or SSM access. Note: the pivot_root confinement means the process cannot traverse above /var/task/sandbox/ even with path traversal in the username field, and the padding oracle attack can only recover token plaintext which contains usernames, expiry timestamps, and role strings - no secrets are accessible via the filesystem even after forging arbitrary tokens.

config.filesystem_confinement: pivot_root to /var/task/sandbox/ via bootstrap extension shim
config.sensitive_data_in_jail: none - /data/profiles/ contains only non-sensitive stubs (display_name, theme_preference)
config.key_material: ephemeral 16-byte key generated per cold-start, not derived from any persistent secret
config.iam_role_permissions: lambda:InvokeFunction only, no data store access
config.oci_layer_config: single layer, no volume mounts, read-only rootfs
